text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Gran Alegria looking
unusually downcast.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha. My family invited me
on a trip, but—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That won't work. On that day,
my schedule is...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Yeah! Have fun!
I'll be looking forward to souvenirs!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...Aaargh! If only I went, that's 600 miles!
Think of how many miles I could've saved up...!
